name: ORRERY-HEIGHT-handles-over-zero
why: the report: every Orrery stone's handles a metre over 0 under a court 15-24 m off it - no stone in any reach, the lock never opened (re-aimed by content at ORRERY-STONES' shift: the stone and its levers stand on the spot's floor)

name: ORRERY-HEIGHT-centimetres-as-metres
why: a spot's height is the law's centimetres: read as metres, the handles stand a hundred times too high (re-aimed at ORRERY-STONES' shift)

name: ORRERY-HEIGHT-no-height-not-zero
why: the laws before THE ASCENT lay no spot height: their handles lost, where they stood a metre over the 0 court (re-aimed at ORRERY-STONES' shift)
